Foil card web overlay

Supplied v0.49.1 candidate textures:
mask.png: txvx_tradingcard_deck_flashcard_mask
noise.png: txvx_tradingcard_deck_flashcard_noise
star.png: txvx_tradingcard_deck_flashcard_star

These are copied unchanged from the user-specified derived-image library.
CSS approximates a foil sheen using the packed-color mask, noise and six staggered star glints.
The exact original prefab/material binding and shader settings remain unverified.
Ownership is driven by has_foil plus a positive copy quantity, independently of Gold and trade_foil.
